notes.title: Jungles of Maxtheria Update
notes.notes:
Version 1.10 of "Jungles of Maxtheria" has been released.
- Changed the controls for the menus.  Before it was up/down to go between the buttons.  Now you can also do left/right.  Some menus are horizontal while others are vertical.  This should make it easier for the first timer to quickly start the game.
- Added some extra content in here and there.
- Fixed animation on some snakes.
- Fixed some language translation issues.
- Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes: If you tried to download JOM and got a 0KB file size, then it has been fixed.  This was only on a certain package mainly for curators/reviewers.  It was just a setting in a steamworks area.  Sorry about that.  Now , you can have fun playing.  Good luck.

notes.title: Jungles of Maxtheria Update
notes.notes:
Version 1.03 of Jungles of Maxtheria has been released.  
     - We added in flags after the white doors at the end of each stage to indicate respawn points.
     - We fixed some minor issues with the text graphics.
     - We fixed a minor bug with one of the baddies.

notes.title: Jungles of Maxtheria Update
notes.notes: "Jungles of Maxtheria" version 1.01 has some minor bug fixes.  These were just fixes for text that did not properly word wrap on some screens at certain monitor resolutions.  No biggie, but looks better now.
